trail.name: Garnet Canyon
trail.coordinateNote: Official NPS Lupine Meadows Trailhead marker; 4.6 m from reviewed route/access geometry. This is an area forecast reference, not navigation or uniform conditions along the route.
trail.planningNote: Long, steep mountain hike: check current conditions with a backcountry ranger. Snow travel may require specialist skills and equipment. The trailhead-area forecast does not represent the higher route. TrailPack covers day-hike packing, not climbing or overnight equipment. NPS describes boulder-field scrambling and route finding; the profile does not cover a Teton summit climb.

additionalSources.note: Official NPS activity-map configuration used to identify the named route corridor; alternate access routes and branches are not silently substituted.

comparison.note: Reviewed NPS-origin USGS segments, with clipped sections and return legs counted explicitly, total 8.239 mi (0.5% versus NPS). This is route-corridor evidence, not a navigation track.

photo.alt: A creek runs through an alpine meadow blooming with wildflowers in front of two mountain peaks.
photo.permissionNote: Reviewed the official NPS page and its NPS photographer credit; no third-party restriction is displayed. Retain attribution and source; no endorsement is implied. Original sharpness reviewed without upscaling.
